import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/test_0.csv"

# Load source tables
# Note: index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per Hint 24
source0_df = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation plan:
# - Target schema: ['V_GENE']
# - Source schema: ['V_CALL']
# - The target column V_GENE corresponds to the source column V_CALL but without the allele suffix (e.g., "*01")
# - So we need to strip off the allele part from V_CALL values to get V_GENE
# - Since there is only one source table, no union or join is needed
# - Output the transformed data to the specified path

# Extract V_GENE by removing the allele suffix from V_CALL
# The allele suffix starts with '*', so split by '*' and take the first part
source0_df['V_GENE'] = source0_df['V_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Select only the target column
target_df = source0_df[['V_GENE']]

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
